select.if:
select DISTINCT t1.TAB_NUM as id, t1.SUB_NAME as text from DIS_POI_SUB t1 where t1.STATUS=#{statusEffective}
and (t1.SUB_NAME like concat('%' , #{search, jdbcType=VARCHAR} , '%') or t1.TAB_NUM like concat('%' , #{search, jdbcType=VARCHAR} , '%'))

select DISTINCT t2.TAB_NUM as id, t2.TAB_NAME as text from DIS_POI_TAB t2 where t2.STATUS=#{statusEffective}
and (t2.TAB_NAME like concat('%' , #{search, jdbcType=VARCHAR} , '%') or t2.TAB_NUM like concat('%' , #{search, jdbcType=VARCHAR} , '%'))
